# George Ishaq

> Personal site of George Ishaq — software engineer. Currently founding engineer at Legion Health (YC); incoming member of technical staff at AppLovin. B.S. Computer Science, Minerva University (2026).

Single-page portfolio built with Astro and Tailwind. Highlights selected work, experience, awards, and current learning interests (mechanistic interpretability).

## Site

- [george.ishaq.com](https://george.ishaq.com): Main page with work, experience, awards, and contact.
- [Resume (PDF)](https://george.ishaq.com/[PUBLIC]George_Ishaq_Resume_Fall_2025.pdf): Latest public resume.

## Selected Work

- [Spark](https://splarve.com): AI game-creation platform — built the agentic code generation that turns prompts into playable games with live preview. TypeScript, Next.js, Claude AI. YC AI Hackathon winner; Minerva capstone.
- [AppLovin Data Challenge](https://github.com/georgeIshaq/Calhacks_AppLovin_Challenge): Optimized queries on a 245M-row / 20GB dataset from 62s to 39ms with pre-aggregated Arrow IPC rollups and an intelligent query router. Python, Polars, DuckDB. Cal Hacks x AppLovin.
